tools.name: get_position_history
tools.description: Every position of a manager, or one position by salt: when it opened, its pool, its lifetime fees and its events. Answered from the index, falling back to the Envelop history API and then to a log scan; the answer says which one served it and how current that source is.

tools.name: list_operators
tools.description: Addresses currently authorised to rebalance a manager's positions. They can never withdraw — that is enforced by the contract. On the scan path the answer may be `partial`, which means a revoked operator could still be listed; from the index it never is.

tools.name: rank_pools
tools.description: Fee APR over the last 24 hours for each pool this manager is configured with, best first — the Uniswap gateway's figure, or the subgraph's last complete day for a pool the gateway does not list (`aprSource`). tools.name: suggest_move
tools.description: Compares the position's current pool against the rest of the manager's set and, when the gap is worth it, returns the numbers for a move: destination pool, ticks, and how much liquidity.
